cds.title: University of Akron Main Campus Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025): applicants, admits and enrollees are the sums of the men, women and unknown-sex counts (6,243+7,187+73 applied; 4,811+5,560+56 admitted; 1,056+1,087+26 enrolled). The residency table gives only enrollees: 2,004 in-state, 140 out-of-state, 25 international. Akron did not report applicants or admits by residency, so no international admit rate is shown. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (0.05% below 1.0 not shown). Undergraduate enrollment is 11,691 (all undergraduates); international undergraduates number 226 (215 degree-seeking), counted as nonresident aliens. Test policy: 'The University of Akron is test optional.' Class rank was reported by only 15.1% of first-years.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2027): 'The University of Akron is test optional.' SAT or ACT is 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set (full 2026-27 year): nonresident and international tuition $19,216 (in-state $11,536) plus $2,400 required fees; food and housing $13,396; books $1,200. Transportation $2,000 (residents) is not included in other costs. Non-need-based aid from the college is available to nonresident aliens; 200 received it (avg $9,112, total $1,822,425; the form flags aid year 2023). The International Center's own estimate (2025-26 rates) is $21,585 tuition and fees, $13,317 room and board, $1,328 health insurance, $2,559 books and personal expenses, total $38,789
